items.quote: 21:14 And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
items.claim: Verse 21:14 says that Abraham got up early, gave Hagar bread and a bottle of water, put it on her shoulder along with the child, and sent her away. It says she then left and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba. This is only what the text says happened; nothing outside the text confirms it.
items.action: sent away, after giving her bread and a bottle of water
